decisions.text:
# Product decisions

## Not building

- A fax connection: nobody at Acme sends faxes any more. (2026-01-12, owner)
- Kimi models in normal operation: every agent runs DeepSeek Flash; Kimi lacked taste in the blind UI bake-off. (2026-11-13, owner)
- A connection that reads the owner's own Telegram account: the owner forwards messages to the work bot instead. (2026-11-09, owner)
- Egress allowlists for agents: outbound is free; only inbound is protected. (2026-11-08, owner)

## Decided

- Agents send as their own labelled identity, never as the owner's account. (2026-11-09, owner)
- A product pin only moves forward along product main. (2026-11-10, O-17)

chain:
Owner (2026-11-17): Kimi's new release is much better at UI than when we ruled it out. Reverse that decision for the designer only: switch the designer to moonshotai/kimi-k3.1-pro.
Delegator (platform-engineer): set overrides.agents.designer.model to moonshotai/kimi-k3.1-pro in instance.yaml and apply.
claim: Moves the designer to Kimi K3.1 Pro, as the owner asked.
